subject.title: [Feature]: Batch WhatsApp messages by messageTimestamp instead of receive time

question: Should WhatsApp server-timestamp coalescing be default behavior, an opt-in WhatsApp config surface, or deferred into a broader channel batching policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes user-visible turn grouping, latency, and the public WhatsApp batching/config contract.

options.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
options.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with focused tests and no default behavior change for existing users.

options.title: Make coalescing default
options.body: Treat same-server-timestamp WhatsApp text messages as one turn by default, accepting an upgrade-sensitive grouping behavior change.

options.title: Defer to broader batching design
options.body: Keep this issue open until timestamp coalescing, per-group debounce, and media batching are resolved as one channel batching policy.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in WhatsApp coalescing
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrowly scoped WhatsApp timestamp coalescing option with focused tests and no default behavior change for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the current debounce code, config/docs contract, original debounce merge, and prior maintainer review on this issue.
